after.rosterkit/notices.py:
# owner: platform
"""Absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short text notice listing the days a student was absent.

    Raises ValueError if a mark belongs to someone else or nothing was missed.
    """
    all_marks = list(marks)
    for mark in all_marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(f"mark for {mark.student_id}, not {student.student_id}")
    days = sorted(m.day for m in all_marks if m.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ValueError(f"no absences for {student.student_id}")
    count = len(days)
    noun = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{name} missed {count} {noun} of school.\nDates absent: {dates}"
